name: isSimpleModule_iff_toSpanSingleton_surjective
statement: IsSimpleModule R M ↔ Nontrivial M ∧ ∀ x : M, x ≠ 0 → Function.Surjective (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R M x) where mp h

name: exists_sSupIndep_sSup_simples_eq_top
statement: ∃ s : Set (Submodule R M), sSupIndep s ∧ sSup s = ⊤ ∧ ∀ m ∈ s, IsSimpleModule R m

name: IsSemisimpleModule.exists_linearEquiv_fin_dfinsupp
statement: ∃ (n : ℕ) (S : Fin n → Submodule R M) (_ : M ≃ₗ[R] Π₀ i : Fin n, S i), ∀ i, IsSimpleModule R (S i)

name: jacobson_density
statement: End (End R M) M) (s : Finset M) : ∃ r : R, ∀ m ∈ s, f m = r • m

have_tree.body: by rw [← this, map_smul, End.smul_def]; apply projection_apply_mem
